template_meta.title: Accommodations (Hotel / Rentals)
template_meta.description: A powerful setup for hotels, vacation rentals, or any multi-day booking system. It demonstrates per-item capacity and uses custom, filterable 'Dimension Attributes' like Bedrooms and Bathrooms. NOTE: You must link each property to a WooCommerce product to enable payments.

clisyc_property.post_excerpt: A beautiful 3-bedroom home right on the water. Requires a 3-night minimum stay.
A stylish 1-bedroom loft in the heart of the city. Perfect for short stays.
A comfortable room with two queen-sized beds. We have 12 of this type available.
